verdict.rationale: Spline documents a natural-language AI Agent that builds/edits 3D scenes ('describe what you want and it does the work'), AI-generated textures via typing, and a Hana screen-design assistant, plus MCP server support letting Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT drive the editor via natural-language commands. This directly satisfies the ai-native/agenticness story with multiple first-party mechanisms. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI Agent's natural-language command fidelity and any reported limitations or failure cases.
